description:
Set a phone number as the primary phone for the account. Always requires one code: start_2fa_for_action with action_type phone_primary (no targets); without it the call answers 403 2fa_required.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account, signed in: call start_login, show the user its challenge, then wait_for_login, then call this tool again. Authenticating this client alone does NOT open this tool.

id.description: Phone record ID to set as primary

name: set_primary_phone
